resources.string: the car only runs the climate remotely with the power switch OFF. Switch the car off (not ACC or ON) and try again.

the car accepted the command but the climate didn’t start. Mitsubishi lists these causes: the power switch is not OFF, quick charging is active, a door is open, the drive battery is too low, or it is too cold (plugging the car in helps with the last two). The log has what the car reported.
The car reports its power switch in ACC/ON. Remote climate only works with the power switch OFF.
Keep car Wi-Fi on
Car Wi-Fi only when off
Staying connected
Keep the car’s Wi-Fi on while the car is on

Off (the car’s default): the car’s Wi-Fi only works while the power switch is OFF. On: it also stays on while the car is switched on. Mitsubishi says to turn it off if you use Smartphone Link Display Audio.
Connect to the car to see and change this setting.

2014–2017 cars switch their Wi-Fi off a little while after the power switch is turned ON, so the app loses the car while it is switched on. It comes back when the car is switched off. These cars have no setting to change this (only 2018 and newer have “Always Communicate”).
The car switches its Wi-Fi off while it is switched on (2018 and newer cars can be set to keep it on — connect once and this card shows the option).
If the connection keeps dropping

• Keep the car switched OFF (ACC also works).
• In the phone’s Wi-Fi settings, turn off options that leave a Wi-Fi without internet: “Adaptive Wi-Fi”, “Switch to mobile data automatically”, “Avoid poor connections” or similar.
• If Android asks whether to stay on a network without internet, choose to stay connected.
• If it still drops, try with mobile data switched off.
• Stay within about 10–20 m of the car; walls shorten the range.
Memory full (3 beeps) or starting over

To delete every phone registered in the car:
1. Close the driver’s door and turn the hazard lights ON.
2. Enter registration mode as in steps 2–3 above.
3. Within 5 minutes, press LOCK and UNLOCK alternately — 20 presses in total, starting with LOCK. One beep = all phones deleted.
This also resets the car’s Wi-Fi name and password to the ones on the card and clears the car’s charging and climate timers. Then register this phone again (if you had changed the Wi-Fi password, enter the one from the card under Car Wi-Fi).
To remove only this phone, tap Unregister while connected.
The car’s Wi-Fi has disappeared

The car switches its Wi-Fi off to protect the 12 V battery, for example after standing a long time. To switch it back on:
1. Switch the car ON for at least 10 seconds.
2. Switch it to ACC and enter registration mode (steps 1–3 above).
3. Connect with the app once, then switch the power OFF.
If it stops again, keep the car in READY for at least 10 minutes so the 12 V battery gets charged.
The car last reported its power switch ON. Its Wi-Fi turns off while the car is switched on — switch the car off and the app reconnects.

“%1$s” connected, but didn’t answer ELM327 commands. It is probably not an ELM327 adapter (for example a scan tool that only works with its own app), so this app can’t use it. Use an ELM327-compatible adapter such as OBDLink LX, MX+ or CX, Vgate iCar Pro or Veepeak. If it is an ELM327 adapter, unplug it for a few seconds and try again.

“%1$s” looks like a %2$s scan tool. Those only work with their maker’s own app and don’t speak ELM327, so this app can’t use it. Use an ELM327-compatible adapter such as OBDLink LX, MX+ or CX, Vgate iCar Pro or Veepeak.
